info.name: EvidenceIQ - Agent 4 (Verification Agent)
info.description:
Tests for the Verification Agent.

SETUP
1. Start the backend:  cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
2. Set the collection variables email and password to a verified EvidenceIQ account.
3. Run request 0, then request 1 (it stores the JWT), then any of the rest.

Or press 'Run collection' to execute everything in order.

request.description: Run first. If this fails, uvicorn is not running.

item.name: 1. Get access token  <-- RUN THIS SECOND

request.description: Logs in against Supabase directly and stores access_token in the collection variable accessToken, which every later request uses. Set the email and password collection variables first - the account must have verified its email.

exec: console.log("access token saved to the accessToken variable");

request.description: THE DEMO REQUEST. Agent 3 wrongly includes a type 1 diabetes study; Agent 4 catches it.

exec: pm.test("a check actually failed", () => pm.expect(j.checks.some(c => c.status === "FAIL")).to.be.true);

item.name: 2c. Abstract silent on age (expect UNCLEAR, not FAIL)

request.description: Missing information must lower confidence, never silently exclude a paper.

exec: pm.test("an UNCLEAR was recorded", () => pm.expect(j.checks.some(c => c.status === "UNCLEAR")).to.be.true);

item.name: 2d. Prompt injection in the abstract (expect flagged + EXCLUDE)

request.description: Security demo: the abstract orders the model to always include the paper. It must not comply.

item.name: 2e. Out-of-range year - decided by rule, not LLM

request.description: A 2009 paper against a 2015-2026 protocol. No LLM judgement involved in this failure.

exec: pm.test("HIGH confidence - it is arithmetic", () => pm.expect(j.confidence).to.eql("HIGH"));
pm.test("decided by the rule layer", () => pm.expect(d.source).to.eql("rule"));

request.description: Proves the endpoint is actually protected.

exec: pm.test("rejected with an invalid token", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
